about.text: Milk fermented with Lactobacillus acidophilus. Interest in it goes back about 80 years, to when it was used to treat intestinal infections. Later studies looked at lactose digestion, cholesterol and cancer, and concluded that any benefit depends on careful choice of strain.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

facts.v: Lactobacillus acidophilus, a probiotic bacterium first isolated from infant faeces in 1900
The US FDA has adjudged the NCFM strain an approved ingredient in beverages and dairy products
